name: kubernetes-ingress-2aa26b8d-blind30
instr:
# A Kubernetes proxy configuration agent misbehaves everywhere — diagnosed without a test suite

We run something that watches declarative objects in a cluster and keeps a live proxy's configuration in step with them. Since taking an update of this deployment, almost nothing we declare reaches the running proxy any more, while the process itself starts up cleanly and reports no errors. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything we have been able to pin down from the outside.

Most of what we ask to have attached to a backend is simply not there afterwards. Asking for its members to be tested with a GET for /healthz changes nothing in the live configuration; asking back which such tests a backend holds returns a failure rather than a list; and pushing a fresh set of them reports success while the live configuration keeps whatever it had, so a pass in which nothing but that list changed is not counted as a change and the proxy is never told to pick it up. Testing members by connecting to port 8080 is broken in the same three ways. Turning on reply compression behaves identically: the processing stage never appears, reading back the stages a backend already has fails, and a pass whose only difference is that list passes as a no-op. Installing a group of directives that rewrite replies — one stamping a header onto every reply, one forcing a 503 status when a condition holds — leaves the live configuration untouched while claiming succes
